docs.text: Back in 2011, I paddled from Port Huron on Lake Huron to Grand Marais, MN on Lake Superior. The trip was ~800 miles. It took 45 days. I wrote a story for Ocean Paddler Magazine, which folded in 2020, but I wanted to make the story available again. www.paddlinglight.com/articles/por...

A Mastodon conversation with .com (on a .net post) is prompting me to play around tonight with mapping #GreatLakes ferries. So let's see how far I get. Warning: Be prepared for me to never finish. But, I begin with some data from OSM (route = ferry) and Natural Earth.

The lakes are joined up, and I made a couple small adjustments. Now I'm doing a pass where I loosely place dots, text, and route lines. Later I will iterate on these (adjusting sizes, colors, etc.), but for now I just want to get them roughly into place so I can see where trouble spots might be.

Some more cleanup, and route/dot placement. Also many big adjustments to lake shapes. Still more to go there, but I'm going to work on finalizing Lake Superior first, so I can decide on style ideas which might have a bearing on how much space I need for the St. Clair Delta, for example.

Last bit for tonight. Finished redrawing the lower lakes. Then roughly juxtaposed them, though I haven't joined them yet. After that it'll be time to take a second pass in finding the balance between "looks sorta geographically right" and "tiny ferry lines are big enough to be the subject"
Lake Huron, before and after. A lot of re-tooling here to try and reduce the amount of not-ferry that is shown. May do more later, but this is again a decent first pass.
Roughly 19 hours Detour is Port Huron. This is the point where the ships leave Lake Huron. This is another nice spot to take pictures of ships.
Maybe we can get an island in the Great lakes or something

That'll do for a first pass. I made the Apostle Islands 3× larger, and Isle Royale 2×. I shrank the eastern half of the lake. It looks messy now, but later on I'll redraw it. I'm using the same general approach as I did for an airline map years ago: somethingaboutmaps.wordpress.com/2018/05/15/o...

First some cleanup. Two layers: compound polys for the water (including relevant rivers/canals that I polygonized), and the OSM routes. Next I'll start deforming .bsky.social. I'm going to take it a lake at a time for now.

Finally, the lower lakes. Lots of tiny ferries here, including across branches of the St. Clair Delta. Added back in some shoreline. I will try to include those on the final piece if I can. Now I'm at a point where I can do some redrawing/simplification, before another round of manual distortion.
